meet.speaker: The Unfinished
text: Oh. You found the part that isn't finished yet.
Don't look too closely. Some of me is still placeholder.

warden.speaker: The Unfinished
text: ...Warden. That name. I was going to give it to someone.
Did you choose it? Or did it choose you?

ask.speaker: The Unfinished
ask.text: You can ask me things. Three things. That's the budget.

a_hollow.speaker: The Unfinished
text: Every story somebody started and didn't finish ends up somewhere.

a_who.speaker: The Unfinished
text: I'm the one who started this story.
I got distracted. Life does that. So it waited here, half-drawn, hoping.

a_why.speaker: The Unfinished
text: That's the question the whole Hollow is built around.
A hint: nobody forgot you by accident.

bye.speaker: The Unfinished
bye.text: Come back. I'm not going anywhere. I literally can't.

done.speaker: The Unfinished
text: That's the budget. Thank you for asking. Most people just walk past.
A secret, for the secret-finder: when this chapter ends, begin again — and use the name I almost gave.

after.speaker: The Unfinished
after.text: The Unfinished waves. Part of its hand isn't drawn yet.
